ProcessNet Examples and Tutorials

Learn ProcessNet through practical examples.

Example 1: Basic Model Creation

This example demonstrates creating a simple two-body pendulum.

using ProcessNet;

// Create application instance
var app = new Application();

// Create new model
var model = app.CreateModel("Pendulum");

// Create ground body
var ground = model.GetGround();

// Create pendulum body
var pendulum = model.CreateBody("Pendulum", 1.0);
pendulum.SetPosition(0, 0, -100);

// Create revolute joint
var joint = model.CreateJoint("Revolute", ground, pendulum);

// Run simulation
model.Run(endTime: 10.0);

Example 2: DOE Batch Execution

Demonstrates running design of experiments with parameter variations.

using ProcessNet;

// Load base model
var model = Model.Load("base_model.rdyn");

// Parameter sweep
for (double stiffness = 1000; stiffness <= 5000; stiffness += 1000)
{
    // Clone model for this run
    var clone = model.Clone();

    // Set parameter
    var spring = clone.GetEntityByID("Spring_1");
    spring.SetParameter("Stiffness", stiffness);

    // Run simulation
    clone.Run();

    // Save results
    clone.SaveAs($"run_k{stiffness}.rdyn");
}

Example 3: Result Post-Processing

Extract and process simulation results.

using ProcessNet.Result;

// Load result file
var result = Result.Load("simulation.res");

// Get time array
double[] time = result.GetTimeArray();

// Get displacement data
double[] displacement = result.GetEntityData("Body_1", "CM_Position_X");

// Export to CSV
result.Export("output.csv", format: "CSV");

Example 4: Model Introspection

Query and inspect model entities.

from processnet import Model

# Load model
model = Model.load("complex_model.rdyn")

# Get all bodies
bodies = model.GetAllBodies()
for body in bodies:
    print(f"Body: {body.GetName()}, Mass: {body.GetMass()}")

# Get all joints
joints = model.GetAllJoints()
for joint in joints:
    print(f"Joint: {joint.GetID()}, Type: {joint.GetType()}")
